title: Robots that learn
summary: We’ve created a robotics system, trained entirely in simulation and deployed on a physical robot, which can learn a new task after seeing it done once.
body: We’ve created a robotics system, trained entirely in simulation and deployed on a physical robot, which can learn a new task after seeing it done once.
summaryZh: OpenAI开发了一套机器人系统，该系统完全在仿真环境中进行训练，并成功部署于物理机器人上。该系统具备单次演示学习（One-shot learning）的能力，即在观察一次任务执行后即可学会新任务。这一成果展示了仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）迁移学习在机器人控制领域的应用前景。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了仿真训练与物理机器人部署的结合，体现了强化学习在机器人领域的应用潜力。
